outcome: frequency of Apgar score below 7 at 5 minutes
cohort: Women with a viable singleton pregnancy who underwent elective or emergency cerclage for cervical insufficiency at the Tongji Hospital, Wuhan, China.
finding: Pregnancy outcomes were similar after emergency and elective cerclage, but within the emergency cerclage group, an inverse trend was observed where women with longer cervical length had better outcomes.
birth_weight: Birth weight was measured for live births and compared between groups.
gest_age: Mean pregnancy length at delivery (a measure of gestational age) was an outcome measured and compared.
